attrs.note: CREATED BY R6, by narrowing `is_ok` to a family a checker can decide. R5.2 carried this same content inside a terminator that said the inference was 'deductively equivalent once the definition is fixed'. That sentence is true of definitional EXPANSION — substituting a registered definiens for a term — and this is definitional SUBSUMPTION, which is deciding that a prose description falls under a definition. Nothing mechanical does that. Making the terminator checkable did not make this argument weaker; it made the artifact say what the argument had always been resting on.
attrs.statement: The object described in LED-FILTER-ODOMETER's refuted proposition — a stopping rule against a pre-specified target — satisfies RRUV 2016's definition of a FILTER, and not their definition of an ODOMETER.
